column5: BIT_COUNT now follows builtinBitCountSig's ETInt cast boundary: signed and UInt payloads preserve their 64 bits, positive string casts parse through UINT64 (including 2^63..=UINT64_MAX and overflow clamping), negative strings clamp below INT64_MIN, and malformed byte prefixes remain consumable; function-class/vectorized/session warning state remains outside the value-only Datum domain
